vopros: Are there private schools in West Los Angeles that offer language immersion from preschool through elementary?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. The clearest West LA match is:

- **Saint Sebastian School** — **1430 Federal Ave., Los Angeles (Sawtelle/West LA)**  
  A private co-ed Catholic school with **Spanish–English dual-language immersion**. It serves **preschool through 8th grade**, so it covers preschool and all elementary years. Its preschool program is described as full Spanish immersion, with a roughly 50/50 Spanish-English model beginning in TK and continuing upward.  
  Website: https://saintsebastianschool.com/

A couple of nearby/Westside possibilities worth verifying directly, depending on the language and exact grades you need:

- **Intiwasi Spanish Immersion School** — **9017 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles**  
  Private Spanish-English immersion program beginning in preschool. Search results indicate it currently extends through the early elementary grades (reported as PK–2), so confirm its current upper-grade expansion if you need all of elementary.

- **Le Lycée Français de Los Angeles, Century City** — **10361 W. Pico Blvd.**  
  Offers French-English bilingual education and preschool in Century City. Confirm directly whether its Century City location currently provides the elementary grades you want, since campus offerings can vary.

If your requirement is specifically **one campus from preschool through at least grade 5**, Saint Sebastian appears to be the most direct fit among these.
